staging.activation_note: The adapter probe is no longer blocked by ACL 42501. Full activation remains fail-closed until pdc-emails produces a real retained-source receipt and authoritative readback.

authentication_diagnosis.root_cause: The old verifier required SPF, DKIM and DMARC booleans all to be true and searched DMARC only for header.from. Gmail's receiver result contains valid aligned SPF and, for Microsoft-forwarded messages, a validated ARC pass with fromdomain; RFC 7489 alignment is an OR of aligned SPF or aligned DKIM.
fail_closed_rules: trust only the first mx.google.com Authentication-Results field
require receiver-authenticated aligned SPF or DKIM
retain the independent enrolled sender/domain policy
reject exact replay when the fetched source hash differs
authentication_diagnosis.unmatched_message_policy: Do not infer authentication. Exact replay must fetch the scoped UID read-only and compare its SHA-256 to the resume manifest before any staging mutation.

resume_commands.command_source: Generate one command per new-build message from latest100-resume-manifest.json; retain UIDVALIDITY 1 and the manifest source_hash exactly.
prohibited_combinations: Do not use a bare numeric UID
Do not continue after source-hash mismatch
Do not enable the scheduler as part of this handoff

child_receipt_contract.parent_hash: not unique; siblings from one physical message are allowed
child_receipt_contract.immutability: enabled receipt and source-row immutable triggers
child_receipt_contract.direct_table_dml: denied to public, anon, authenticated and service_role
child_receipt_contract.independent_processing: sync_canonical_attachment_imports processes each manifest child separately; a sibling failure is recorded/retried without borrowing sibling identity
